title: Cutaway Wrinkled Shell and Paired Cotyledon Walnut
description: One wholly newly authored walnut teaching cutaway at approximately four-centimetre fruit size. A continuous corrugated posterior hard shell retains its inner cavity and broad cut rim, while the front shell section is intentionally absent to expose two complete wrinkled cotyledons seated beside a whole central brown packing septum. Real low-poly relief rather than image or procedural textures describes broad shell furrows and kernel folds. The source has independent shell cross-sections, continuous lobed kernel surfaces and a complete partition; no pomegranate rind, aril cluster, calyx, peanut exterior, old seed mesh, recolour or number variation is reused. One complete teaching prop, zero scenes, four opaque solid PBR roles. This is a sectional display, not an intact fruit or a naturally open hinged nut. The green outer husk and front hard shell are deliberately omitted; the narrow flat shell base is a display datum. Broad exterior/internal relationships only, not measured cultivar anatomy, complete embryo axis or vascular tissues, exact material fracture, living germination, nutrition, food safety, edibility, medical effects, physical stability, rig or animation.
